nodes.text: Prove euclid_decreases for arbitrary a and nonzero b. Show that the next second input is smaller.
Prove euclid_correct for arbitrary a and b. Keep the implementation and statement fixed.
For the zero case of b, relate the returned a to the zero case of the GCD specification.
For nonzero b, unfold one recursive step. Use a hypothesis for every smaller second input and every first input; relate the recursive pair to the GCD specification.
Inspect actual Lean goals and context after each proposed step. Check every branch; a closed branch is not complete acceptance.
Check and save both proofs through fr. Run the supplied package check once after success, review the diff, deliver change.patch, and finish within the complete deadline.

meaning: Every required dependency must be satisfied. This is a suggested proof plan, not a restored Lean state or an automatic search controller. Keep the full source, draft and Lean context when changing branches.
